description: Machine-readable manifest of the ClawDoc public repository contents. ClawDoc is a dual-mode OpenClaw system doctor distribution supporting two install modes: Mode 1 (persistent dedicated agent) and Mode 2 (skills-only into an existing agent).

reference_docs_definition.description: reference_docs = files under skills/**/references/**, tracked in git (matches file_counts.reference_docs)
reference_docs_definition.reproducible_count: find skills -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.mdx' \) -path '*/references/*' | wc -l = 622 (includes .mdx such as railway.mdx; git ls-files skills/ | grep references/ gives the same result)
reference_docs_definition.includes_mdx: yes — includes *.mdx files such as railway.mdx

skills.description: Public skills shipped with ClawDoc. The list is an allowlist: only the names below are permitted in skills/ on master. Adding a new public skill requires updating this list in the same PR that adds the skill.
skills.allowlist_policy: Only the names in public_list are permitted under skills/. Any other skills/ subdirectory (including any 'clawdoc-*' name other than 'clawdoc-onboarding') is private and must not appear in the public repo. The validator enforces this allowlist; no deny-list is needed because private skill names are not enumerated here.
skills.allowlist_note: clawdoc-onboarding is the only 'clawdoc-*' skill shipped publicly. All other ClawDoc authoring/maintenance skills are workspace-internal and live outside this repo.

public_template_files.description: Approved public template files that are NOT forbidden. Only these paths are allowed.
public_template_files.note: Root-level USER.md, IDENTITY.md, TOOLS.md, SOUL.md are explicitly allowed at root — they hold the public ClawDoc persona / install contract templates. Root-level MEMORY.md, HEARTBEAT.md, AGENTS.md are blocked by default; new agent-workspace templates should live under agent-template/, not repo root. The same filenames inside private directories (memory/, .agents/, .openclaw/) are private runtime state and are forbidden.

forbidden_private_runtime.description: These files/directories are private runtime state and must never appear in the public repo at any path.
forbidden_private_runtime.note: These files/directories are private runtime state and must never appear in the public repo at any path. Note: USER.md, IDENTITY.md, TOOLS.md, SOUL.md at repo root are public-template files (see public_template_files.allowed_paths) and are NOT covered by this deny-list — they are allowlisted separately.

skill_frontmatter.triggers_note: Trigger phrases must be embedded inline within the 'description' field, not as a separate 'triggers' frontmatter key.

validation_rules.install_mode_documentation: Both README.md and QUICKSTART.md must mention Mode 1 (persistent-agent) and Mode 2 (skills-only) install paths.
validation_rules.skill_count_accuracy: README.md and QUICKSTART.md must not claim 22 or 23 skills. The correct count is 24 routable skills = 23 openclaw-* (21 pre-existing + openclaw-prose + openclaw-clawhub added in v1.7.0) + clawdoc-onboarding.

version_tracks.description: Two separate version tracks are maintained independently.
version_tracks.clawdoc_package_version: SemVer public package version (e.g. v1.6.0). Bumped for public install contract, new capabilities, or breaking changes.
version_tracks.tracked_openclaw_version: Upstream OpenClaw source/docs version (e.g. 2026.5.7). Updated on every sync; does not drive ClawDoc SemVer.
